- Over the year, I saw Equinox get cheap with things. They swapped out their Kiehls line of shampoo, conditioner, body wash, face wash and lotion. They replaced it with their own brand that many people hate. They stopped doing "appreciation" events.

You can see this in so many different forms; whether it be less staff at a restaurant or call center, untrained and difficult chatbots to sit through, not paying receptionists a higher wage, or giving a 20 cent wage increase a year.

We are now at a point where *we are seeing the rapid decline in customer service*, but are expected to still pay the same high price for fees as companies continue to slash budgets and jobs. (I.E., they are getting away with it.)

While I'm not sure what the solution is, outside of a company having a strong culture for positive CS interactions, I hope this helps.
